project_title: Luxury Content Creator for Business Pitches and Brochures

project_metadata.job_title: Luxury Content Creator for Business Pitches and Brochures
project_metadata.job_description: We are seeking a skilled content creator who specializes in crafting luxurious and captivating business pitches, brochures, and portfolios. The ideal candidate will have a keen eye for detail and the ability to convey our brand's values through high-quality content. Your work will be pivotal in impressing stakeholders and clients, so a strong background in luxury branding is essential. Please showcase your previous work that aligns with high-end demands.

I want to make sure we both have the same understanding. Our original discussion covered image design only, rather than a complete monthly hiring arrangement, and honestly, that kind of arrangement is not suitable for me at this stage.
The agreed payment was $100 for this work, which is approximately $13 for each image/page. However, the requested workload and revisions now exceed what we initially discussed.
I’ve made a genuine effort to cooperate and have completed several changes, but it is not accurate to repeatedly request major redesigns while describing the work as “template-based.” I possess all the original source files, and every item was properly created from scratch.
The scope has clearly expanded at this point. Continuing with more revisions or extra work will require the price to be adjusted accordingly. If not, I cannot keep making additional changes under the existing terms.

Once April 25 has passed, I will have to raise my charges because I have already spent more than a month working on this project. This situation prevents me from progressing efficiently. Sometimes I am expected to follow Samuel’s directions, while at other times I must follow yours, creating an inconsistent workflow. I cannot continue working in this manner.
If you are comfortable with this arrangement, that is fine. If not, I kindly ask that we wind up the project here. The total payment is \$150, although the work consists of more than 20 pages and has already required over a month.
I have repeatedly asked you to accept the Upwork milestone, but it still has not been accepted. I have cooperated fully from my side, yet my concerns continue to be disregarded. It is also not reasonable for me to work according to instructions from two separate people.

Thank you for understanding.
